sam_finance: Hey team — vendor NordicShip Ltd sent invoice #2026-1023. Their customs paperwork lists EORI GB123456789000 but the invoice shows VAT ID NL123456789B01. They also have a line that says 'import VAT to be settled by customer / gross-up included'. Can we pay as-is or ask for reissue?

marie_tax: Short answer: we need the invoice to reflect the tax treatment that matches the seller's legal VAT registration. EORI is for customs; it doesn't replace a VAT registration number on an invoice. If the supplier is established in NL but imported goods via GB, that mismatch needs clarity.

olga_ops: Vendor claims goods shipped from UK warehouse. If they provided GB EORI for customs, vendor should issue invoice with the correct VAT country and number or add a clear note about: "import VAT borne by buyer" + value of gross-up.

devon_accounting: Holding payment until clarified. What exactly should we ask them to reissue with? I don't want back-and-forth.

marie_tax: Ask them to reissue with one of the following, depending on scenario:
```
1) If seller is VAT-registered in NL and transaction is export of goods to us: invoice should show NL VAT ID, VAT 0% with reference to export rule, and shipping docs.
2) If seller is UK-established and charged import VAT: invoice should show GB VAT ID and explicit VAT lines, or show net + a separate 'import VAT charge / gross-up' line with amounts.
3) If reverse charge applies (B2B services): include buyer VAT ID and note 'reverse charge' and VAT omitted.
```
Also ask them to attach the VAT certificate (or proof of registration) and a copy of the customs entry showing EORI used.

sam_finance: OK. I'll draft a short message. Anything else for AP to accept?

devon_accounting: We need a corrected invoice PDF and an email confirmation stating which entity (NL or GB) is invoicing us. Also want an invoice that matches accounting fields: invoice date, supplier VAT ID, gross/net/VAT line, PO reference.

clara_legal: One legal note — if vendor intends us to gross-up for import VAT, we need a written indemnity that they're not passing hidden customs penalties. Also confirm whether they want us to reclaim import VAT (we normally don't) or whether they expect it to be part of the invoice and then reimburse.

olga_ops: Suggested message to vendor (short):
"Please reissue invoice #2026-1023 to show the correct VAT registration number for the invoicing entity and break out any import VAT/gross-up amounts. Attach VAT registration proof and customs entry (EORI). If invoicing under reverse charge, state our VAT ID and the reverse charge reference. We will hold payment until corrected invoice received."

sam_finance: I'll send that now. @invoices-bot — logging hold on invoice 2026-1023 for vendor follow-up.

invoices-bot: Invoice 2026-1023 status updated: HOLD — missing/ambiguous tax info. Triggered by sam_finance.

marie_tax: One more practical tip: ask vendor to include the country code prefix on the VAT ID (GB: GB..., NL: NL...). That avoids ambiguity.

devon_accounting: Thx. Once they send corrected PDF, I'll process payment. If they insist on gross-up, we need the math: show net, import VAT rate, and total.

sam_finance: Vendor replied by DM: they will reissue with GB VAT number and attach customs entry. ETA 48h. I'll post update here when it arrives.

clara_legal: Cool. Keep the indemnity point in mind if they push gross-up.

sam_finance: Update 36h later — vendor reissued invoice #2026-1023_rev1.pdf showing GB VAT ID GB999888777 and a separate line: 'Import VAT reimbursed to seller: EUR 145.32'. They attached customs entry and VAT cert. Ready for AP?

devon_accounting: Reviewed. Fields OK. Need internal approval for gross-up reimbursement amount (policy check) — @marie_tax can you confirm tax reclaimability?

marie_tax: Looks fine from tax perspective: import VAT was paid by seller and documented; reimbursing the seller is allowed but we should code it to import_vat_reimbursements ledger and note supporting docs. No VAT charged on invoice (it's reimbursement), so no extra VAT reclaim on our returns.

devon_accounting: Great. I'll queue payment today under HOLD-RELEASE once ledger code added.

sam_finance: Marking thread resolved — invoice processed after reissue. Thanks all :thumbsup:
